Recipes RIPA buffer 50 mmol/l Tris-HCl (pH 8.0) 0.25 mol/l NaCl 5 mmol/l EDTA 1% Triton X-100 (v/v)

steps.title: Prepare RIPA buffer (no Triton)
steps.instruction: Make RIPA buffer by mixing 50 mmol L⁻¹ Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0), 0.25 mol L⁻¹ NaCl, and 5 mmol L⁻¹ EDTA; do not add Triton X‑100 at this stage.

steps.title: Harvest and snap‑freeze adipose tissue
steps.instruction: Collect mouse adipose depots (e.g., sWAT, eWAT, BAT), place them on dry ice or directly into liquid nitrogen and store frozen until processing.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue and remove fat cake
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of the prepared RIPA buffer (without Triton) containing one cOmplete Mini, EDTA‑free protease inhibitor tablet (and optional phosphatase inhibitors) to ~100 mg of frozen adipose tissue placed in a 2.0‑mL Safe‑Lock tube with one 5 mm stainless‑steel bead. Homogenize with a TissueLyser II at the highest frequency for 3–5 min until the suspension looks clear. Keep the tube on ice, then centrifuge at 6,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C. Carefully remove the white lipid “fat cake” that forms on top of the aqueous layer and resuspend the remaining loose pellet; alternatively, pierce the fat cake with a pipette tip and transfer the entire solution plus pellet to a new 1.5‑mL tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL RIPA buffer (no Triton) + protease inhibitor tablet to ~100 mg tissue in a 2.0‑mL tube with one 5 mm bead.
Homogenize on TissueLyser II, highest frequency, 3–5 min until clear.
Remove the fat cake and resuspend pellet (or transfer with pipette tip to a new 1.5‑mL tube).

steps.title: Add Triton, incubate and clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Add Triton X‑100 to the suspension to reach a final concentration of 1 % (v/v), mix well and keep on ice. Incubate the lysate at 4 °C for 30–60 min. Centrifuge at 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C. Remove the upper lipid layer and transfer the clear supernatant to a fresh 1.5‑mL tube. For maximal lipid removal, repeat the centrifugation and supernatant transfer step twice more (optional).

substeps.instruction: Add Triton X‑100 to 1 % (v/v), mix, keep on ice.
Remove upper lipid layer, transfer supernatant to new 1.5‑mL tube.
Optional: repeat the centrifugation and transfer twice for extra lipid removal.

steps.title: Store protein extracts at –80 °C
steps.instruction: Aliquot the clarified protein lysates and store them at –80 °C until protein concentration determination (e.g., BCA assay) or downstream applications such as Western blotting.
